- operation_result_type: nonempty string
- interpretation: nonempty string
- evidence_refs: array[string]
- contrary_evidence_considered: array[string]
- uncertainty: nonempty string
- assumptions: array[string]
- recommended_state_transition: nonempty string
- recommended_action: nonempty string
- next_evidence_need: nonempty string
- next_focus_proposal: nonempty string
ID ARRAY RULES:
- array values for evidence/ref fields must be exact IDs, never evidence summaries or prose
- evidence_refs values must be chosen from: b_runtime_surface, b_schema_checkpoint, b_user_target
- contrary_evidence_considered values must be chosen from: b_prior_block
- contrary_evidence_considered must include at least one contrary_evidence ID
TASK: perform only operation compare_evidence. Allowed transition/next-operation values: add_supporting_evidence, add_conflicting_evidence, weaken_hypothesis, revise_hypothesis. For recommended_state_transition or recommended_next_operation, copy exactly one allowed value with no new label. Use evidence_refs only from evidence_for IDs: b_runtime_surface, b_schema_checkpoint, b_user_target. Use contrary_evidence_considered only from contrary_evidence IDs: b_prior_block. If contrary_evidence is not empty, the interpretation must state how it changes or weakens the hypothesis Empty strings are invalid for required text fields. The uncertainty value must be a nonempty phrase naming what remains unresolved. Do not copy field descriptions as answers. Do not claim the loop, task, system, or episode is successful or complete. Do not choose declare_insufficient_evidence when both evidence_for and contrary_evidence are supplied.
